PM: In Property Tree, enter vacate information for the tenancy

WRE form received from owner advising of sale
42 days' notice provided to tenant, if vacant possession is needed
If management is retained — notification-of-successor letter sent to tenant
Bond / vacate inspection completed and refund form sent off
Follow up outstanding invoices and work orders not yet completed
Cancel regular maintenance (e.g. grounds)
“Service Ending” or 63/90 day notice sent to tenants
Correspondence sent to owner confirming loss of management and termination date
Follow up invoices not yet received for completed work
Complete open maintenance in the system
Complete / cancel open inspections
Cancel regular maintenance (e.g. grounds)
Prepare paperwork for collection (ledger, ingoing, notices, HHS docs etc.)
Ingoing inspection
Rent ledger (on the final day of tenancy)
Change of landlord — let Natalie know who's taking over management (name, email, LL number)
Keys
HHS report
Tenancy agreement
Ownership funds placed on hold until all invoices/fees/charges are paid (check not on weekly payout)
COL submitted
Final owner payout — usually last day of management or tenancy; pay all invoices first
Remove key number from PT & the Key Numbers spreadsheet, add to bottom of sheet (note the key number in the LM alert in PT)
Remove key off wall and re-tag; give to PM
Archive property / owner (where applicable)

PM: In Property Tree, enter vacate information for the tenancy

WRE form received from owner advising of sale
42 days' notice provided to tenant, if vacant possession is needed
If management is retained — notification-of-successor letter sent to tenant
Bond / vacate inspection completed and refund form sent off
Follow up outstanding invoices and work orders not yet completed
Cancel regular maintenance (e.g. grounds)
“Service Ending” or 63/90 day notice sent to tenants
Correspondence sent to owner confirming loss of management and termination date
Follow up invoices not yet received for completed work
Complete open maintenance in the system
Complete / cancel open inspections
Cancel regular maintenance (e.g. grounds)
Prepare paperwork for collection (ledger, ingoing, notices, HHS docs etc.)
Ingoing inspection
Rent ledger (on the final day of tenancy)
Change of landlord — let Natalie know who's taking over management (name, email, LL number)
Keys
HHS report
Tenancy agreement
Ownership funds placed on hold until all invoices/fees/charges are paid (check not on weekly payout)
COL submitted
Final owner payout — usually last day of management or tenancy; pay all invoices first
Remove key number from PT & the Key Numbers spreadsheet, add to bottom of sheet (note the key number in the LM alert in PT)
Remove key off wall and re-tag; give to PM
Archive property / owner (where applicable)

PM: In Property Tree, enter vacate information for the tenancy

WRE form received from owner advising of sale
42 days' notice provided to tenant, if vacant possession is needed
If management is retained — notification-of-successor letter sent to tenant
Bond / vacate inspection completed and refund form sent off
Follow up outstanding invoices and work orders not yet completed
Cancel regular maintenance (e.g. grounds)
“Service Ending” or 63/90 day notice sent to tenants
Correspondence sent to owner confirming loss of management and termination date
Follow up invoices not yet received for completed work
Complete open maintenance in the system
Complete / cancel open inspections
Cancel regular maintenance (e.g. grounds)
Prepare paperwork for collection (ledger, ingoing, notices, HHS docs etc.)
Ingoing inspection
Rent ledger (on the final day of tenancy)
Change of landlord — let Natalie know who's taking over management (name, email, LL number)
Keys
HHS report
Tenancy agreement
Ownership funds placed on hold until all invoices/fees/charges are paid (check not on weekly payout)
COL submitted
Final owner payout — usually last day of management or tenancy; pay all invoices first
Remove key number from PT & the Key Numbers spreadsheet, add to bottom of sheet (note the key number in the LM alert in PT)
Remove key off wall and re-tag; give to PM
Archive property / owner (where applicable)

PM: In Property Tree under Property Details, lost management information entered and 'Not for Relet' ticked
PM: In Property Tree, enter vacate information for the tenancy
Admin: Lost management information entered into All Clear (Natalie to enter)
WRE form received from owner advising of sale
42 days' notice provided to tenant, if vacant possession is needed
If management is retained — notification-of-successor letter sent to tenant
Bond / vacate inspection completed and refund form sent off
Follow up outstanding invoices and work orders not yet completed
Cancel regular maintenance (e.g. grounds)
“Service Ending” or 63/90 day notice sent to tenants
Correspondence sent to owner confirming loss of management and termination date
Follow up invoices not yet received for completed work
Complete open maintenance in the system
Complete / cancel open inspections
Cancel regular maintenance (e.g. grounds)
Prepare paperwork for collection (ledger, ingoing, notices, HHS docs etc.)
Ingoing inspection
Rent ledger (on the final day of tenancy)
Change of landlord — let Natalie know who's taking over management (name, email, LL number)
Keys
HHS report
Tenancy agreement
Ownership funds placed on hold until all invoices/fees/charges are paid (check not on weekly payout)
COL submitted
Final owner payout — usually last day of management or tenancy; pay all invoices first
Remove key number from PT & the Key Numbers spreadsheet, add to bottom of sheet (note the key number in the LM alert in PT)
Remove key off wall and re-tag; give to PM
Archive property / owner (where applicable)
Archive filing / All Clear / Inspection Manager / property photos / TPS
Mark task as 'Done' in PT
